title: A Phase 2 Study of Imzokitug in Combination with Pumitamig and Platinum-Doublet Chemotherapy as First-line Treatment for Participants with Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
official: A Phase 2, Randomized, Open-label, Study Assessing the Safety, Tolerability and Efficacy of Imzokitug in Combination with Pumitamig and Platinum-Doublet Chemotherapy (PDCT) versus Pumitamig and PDCT as First-line Treatment for Participants with Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
summary: Main objective: Compare the anti-tumor activity, specifically the objective response rate (ORR) of imzokitug and pumitamig in combination with histology-based platinum doublet chemotherapy (PDCT) versus pumitamig and PDCT.  The ORR is the percentage of patients whose cancer shrinks or disappears after treatment, calculated by summing the complete (CR) and partial responders (PR).
conditions: Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

interventions.name: Entyvio 300 mg powder for concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants must have measurable disease per RECIST v1.1; an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 or 1; participants cannot have had any medicine that treats cancer for advanced or metastatic cancer before joining this study.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Untreated symptomatic central nervous system metastases. Participants with any documented actionable genomic alternations (AGAs) (EGFR/ALK/ROS1/NTRK/MET/BRAF/RET mutations) amenable to targeted therapies. Participants with any known medical condition that, in the investigator’s opinion, would increase the risk associated with study participation or study drug administration or interfere with the interpretation of safety results.
